import numpy as np

# Q4 averages for 2-year Treasury note auction amounts accepted
# Year, Average (in millions)

years = [1987, 1988, 1989, 1990]
averages = [
    (10869 + 9347 + 10643) / 3,  # Q4 1987
    (9014 + 9027 + 9030) / 3,     # Q4 1988
    (12322 + 12578 + 12002) / 3,  # Q4 1989
    (13612 + 13852 + 9054) / 3    # Q4 1990
]

print("Q4 2-year Note Auction Averages:")
for y, a in zip(years, averages):
    print(f"  {y}: ${a:.2f} million")

# Compute linear regression (slope of best fit line)
x = np.array(years)
y = np.array(averages)

# Using least squares
n = len(x)
sum_x = np.sum(x)
sum_y = np.sum(y)
sum_xy = np.sum(x * y)
sum_x2 = np.sum(x**2)

slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x**2)

print(f"\nSlope of best-fit line: {slope:.2f} million/year")
print(f"Slope rounded to nearest whole number: {round(slope)}")

EOF

## Results Summary
